title: Valid evaluation lift supports point-surjectivity
situation: Abstract conditional point semantics over identity-related integer rings with zero ideals; admissible evaluations are an additional premise. This is not a standard algebraic-point elimination theorem.

exact_contraction.formula: For every g, g = 0 iff identity(g) = 0
exact_contraction.justification: identity embedding and the same zero ideal at both endpoints

inputs.ideal_vanishing: Every value equals the distinguished Unit zero

valid_evaluation_lift.construction: Reuse each target evaluation as the source evaluation
valid_evaluation_lift.validity: Both evaluation predicates are always True
valid_evaluation_lift.retained_coordinate_equality: identity embedding gives equality for every integer

attempted_conclusion: Every valid target point has a valid source lift with equal retained coordinates, using the supplied valid evaluation lift.

expected.reason: The identity lift preserves all coordinates and ideal vanishing; both validity predicates hold. This conditional expectation does not assert an executed checker admission.
